summary: Measure idle-stop private reclamation across a birth-fenced Linux seat process tree

replay.detail: Measurements remain ephemeral; completed action receipts still own suspension outcomes.

schema.detail: No claim or database schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Linux measurements sum smaps_rollup Private_Clean and Private_Dirty for the runtime-authorized root and descendants discovered through every thread. Birth, ancestry, topology, malformed data or coverage changes make private memory unknown. RSS and Private_Hugetlb are not included. Other platforms remain absent.

downtime.detail: Sampling occurs at the existing reversible idle-stop boundary; no polling or fleet changes.

recovery.detail: A completed whole-seat stop accounts for known pre-stop private bytes without treating a missing procfs sensor as zero. Missing pre-stop evidence remains unknown, including after daemon restart.
